about: The compensated aperture filter of the DES Y3 Map3 measurement at its four radii: the real-space weight U_R(theta) times R^2 and the Fourier window Uhat(ell R) = (ell R)^2/2 exp(-(ell R)^2/2), with each window's peak at ell = sqrt(2)/R.  Written by the export cell of aperture_mass_statistic.ipynb, Section 2.
